sections.title: باب 2 — متن (2)

paras.text: In this way, if the walls of the heart are examined, the walls of the heart appear to consist of three layers. The outer layer is called the pericardium (Pericardium), the middle layer the myocardium (Myocardium) and in this way the inner layer the endocardium (Endocardium). From the membrane of the outer layer a special kind of fluid comes out, which is called pericardial fluid (Pericardial Fluid), because of which the movement of the heart takes place easily.

sections.theory:
In this way, if the walls of the heart are examined, the walls of the heart appear to consist of three layers. The outer layer is called the pericardium (Pericardium), the middle layer the myocardium (Myocardium) and in this way the inner layer the endocardium (Endocardium). From the membrane of the outer layer a special kind of fluid comes out, which is called pericardial fluid (Pericardial Fluid), because of which the movement of the heart takes place easily.

Chambers of Heart

The human heart has four chambers.

1. Right atrium (Right Atrium)

2. Left atrium (Left Atrium)

3. Right ventricle (Right Ventricle)

4. Left ventricle (Left Ventricle)

The right atrium is joined with the right ventricle and the left atrium with the left ventricle through valves (Valves). These same valves maintain the one-way flow of blood inside the heart and stop the reverse flow of blood.
